project: Heyting Guard Synthesis & Kripke-Joyal CFG Semantics

nodes.informal_claim: In any Heyting algebra, a meet (a => b) <= b.
In any Heyting algebra, if a meet g <= b then g <= (a => b).
By the Heyting adjunction, a meet g <= b iff g <= (a => b).
For any Kripke-Joyal CFG transfer T with GaloisConnection post pullback, T.post (a meet synthesizeEdgeGuard T a b) <= b.
For any Kripke-Joyal CFG transfer T with GaloisConnection post pullback, if T.post (a meet g) <= b then g <= synthesizeEdgeGuard T a b.
Across two CFG branch transitions T1 and T2, T1.post (a meet g) <= b1 and T2.post (a meet g) <= b2 iff g <= synthesizeEdgeGuard T1 a b1 meet synthesizeEdgeGuard T2 a b2.
Every CFGTransfer T preserves binary meets on pullbacks: T.pullback (b1 meet b2) = T.pullback b1 meet T.pullback b2.
Guard synthesis across a composed path T1.comp T2 equals nested stage-by-stage guard synthesis: synthesizeEdgeGuard (T1.comp T2) a c = synthesizeEdgeGuard T1 a (T2.pullback c).

Synthesizing a guard for a conjunction b1 meet b2 at the target block equals the meet of the synthesized guards: synthesizeEdgeGuard T a (b1 meet b2) = synthesizeEdgeGuard T a b1 meet synthesizeEdgeGuard T a b2.
Given two converging CFG paths P1, P2 : CFGTransfer alpha gamma, P1.post (a meet g) join P2.post (a meet g) <= c iff g <= synthesizeEdgeGuard P1 a c meet synthesizeEdgeGuard P2 a c.
A predicate inv is a forward loop invariant (L.post inv <= inv) iff it is Kripke-Joyal stable under back-edge pullback (inv <= L.pullback inv).
IsLoopInvariant L inv holds iff the abductive loop-step guard is trivial (synthesizeLoopStepGuard L inv = top).
Conjoining any candidate invariant inv with its abductive loop-step guard guarantees the invariant holds after executing the loop body: L.post (inv meet synthesizeLoopStepGuard L inv) <= inv.
If inv1 and inv2 are both loop invariants for L, their conjunction inv1 meet inv2 is also a loop invariant.
If IsLoopInvariant L inv, then inv is preserved across two back-to-back iterations: (L.comp L).post inv <= inv.
If IsInductiveFor L inv target, conjoining preheader state a0 with hoistLoopGuard E a0 inv establishes target on loop entry: E.post (a0 meet hoistLoopGuard E a0 inv) <= target.
If IsLoopInvariant L inv, conjoining a0 with hoistLoopGuard E a0 inv preserves inv after executing the preheader followed by the loop body: L.post (E.post (a0 meet hoistLoopGuard E a0 inv)) <= inv.

If IsInductiveFor L inv target, the hoisted preheader guard guarantees target still holds after executing the preheader followed by the loop body: L.post (E.post (a0 meet hoistLoopGuard E a0 inv)) <= target.
If IsLoopInvariant L inv, then inv is preserved across any number of loop iterations: forall n : Nat, (L.iterate n).post inv <= inv.
If IsLoopInvariant L inv, then inv is Kripke-Joyal stable under pullback along any n-fold loop path: forall n : Nat, inv <= (L.iterate n).pullback inv.

If IsLoopInvariant L inv, the single preheader guard hoistLoopGuard E a0 inv preserves inv after entering the loop and running n iterations: forall n : Nat, (L.iterate n).post (E.post (a0 meet hoistLoopGuard E a0 inv)) <= inv.

If IsInductiveFor L inv target, the hoisted preheader guard guarantees target holds after entering the loop and running n iterations: forall n : Nat, (L.iterate n).post (E.post (a0 meet hoistLoopGuard E a0 inv)) <= target.
Across any CFGTransfer T, ForcesAfter T a q iff Forces a (T.pullback q).
At stage a, a guarded stage a meet g forces p iff g forces the synthesized guard (Forces (a meet g) p iff Forces g (synthesizeGuard a p)).
For two conditional rewrite preconditions p1 and p2, Forces (a meet g) (p1 meet p2) iff Forces g (synthesizeGuard a p1 meet synthesizeGuard a p2).
If IsInductiveFor L inv target, then for every iteration count n : Nat, the guarded preheader stage forces target along the composed morphism E.comp (L.iterate n).
Any term t is guardedly equivalent to itself under top (GuardedEquiv eval top t t).
Guarded equivalence is symmetric: GuardedEquiv eval p t1 t2 -> GuardedEquiv eval p t2 t1.
Chaining two conditional rewrites GuardedEquiv eval p1 t1 t2 and GuardedEquiv eval p2 t2 t3 yields GuardedEquiv eval (p1 meet p2) t1 t3.

Given GuardedEquiv eval p1 t1 t2 and GuardedEquiv eval p2 t2 t3, at any stage a, conjoining a with synthesizeGuard a p1 meet synthesizeGuard a p2 guarantees eval (a meet (synthesizeGuard a p1 meet synthesizeGuard a p2)) t1 = eval (a meet (synthesizeGuard a p1 meet synthesizeGuard a p2)) t3.
If Forces p q and GuardedEquiv eval q t1 t2, then GuardedEquiv eval p t1 t2.
If GuardedEquiv eval_beta q t1 t2, then GuardedEquiv (pullbackEval T eval_beta) (T.pullback q) t1 t2.
If GuardedEquiv eval_beta q t1 t2, then at any upstream stage a, eval_beta (T.post (a meet synthesizeEdgeGuard T a q)) t1 = eval_beta (T.post (a meet synthesizeEdgeGuard T a q)) t2.

If IsInductiveFor L inv q and GuardedEquiv eval_beta q t1 t2, then for every iteration count n : Nat, eval_beta ((E.comp (L.iterate n)).post (a0 meet hoistLoopGuard E a0 inv)) t1 = eval_beta ((E.comp (L.iterate n)).post (a0 meet hoistLoopGuard E a0 inv)) t2.
If CompatibleOp2 eval op semOp, GuardedEquiv eval p1 t1 u1, and GuardedEquiv eval p2 t2 u2, then GuardedEquiv eval (p1 meet p2) (op t1 t2) (op u1 u2).

Under CompatibleOp2 eval op semOp, GuardedEquiv eval p1 t1 u1, and GuardedEquiv eval p2 t2 u2, at any stage a, conjoining a with synthesizeGuard a p1 meet synthesizeGuard a p2 guarantees eval (a meet (synthesizeGuard a p1 meet synthesizeGuard a p2)) (op t1 t2) = eval (a meet (synthesizeGuard a p1 meet synthesizeGuard a p2)) (op u1 u2).
Across any T : CFGTransfer alpha beta, GuardedEquiv (pullbackEval T eval_beta) (T.pullback (q1 meet q2)) t1 t2 iff GuardedEquiv (pullbackEval T eval_beta) (T.pullback q1 meet T.pullback q2) t1 t2.

Given two converging CFG paths P1, P2 : CFGTransfer alpha gamma and GuardedEquiv eval_gamma c t1 t2, defining g := synthesizeEdgeGuard P1 a c meet synthesizeEdgeGuard P2 a c guarantees both eval_gamma (P1.post (a meet g)) t1 = eval_gamma (P1.post (a meet g)) t2 and eval_gamma (P2.post (a meet g)) t1 = eval_gamma (P2.post (a meet g)) t2.
For any concrete state transition step : S1 -> S2, (stateTransfer step).pullback Q s1 iff Q (step s1).
For any concrete state transition step : S1 -> S2, synthesizeEdgeGuard (stateTransfer step) P Q s1 iff (P s1 -> Q (step s1)).
For any concrete loop step : S -> S and inv : S -> Prop, IsLoopInvariant (stateTransfer step) inv iff forall s, inv s -> inv (step s).

For concrete transitions init : S0 -> S and step : S -> S, if IsInductiveFor (stateTransfer step) inv q and GuardedEquiv eval q t1 t2, then the hoisted preheader guard guarantees eval equality across all n iterations.
Computable Heyting guard synthesis function on GuardIR syntax.
Computable context-sensitive guarded expression optimizer on Expr.
GuardedEquiv (liftEval run) P t1 t2 iff forall s, P s -> run s t1 = run s t2.
Expr.add is denotationally compatible (CompatibleOp2) with liftEval evalExpr and liftBinarySem (+).
Expr.checkedDiv is denotationally compatible (CompatibleOp2) with liftEval evalExpr and liftBinarySem checked-division.
denoteGuard (synthesizeGuardIR a b) = synthesizeGuard (denoteGuard a) (denoteGuard b).
denoteGuard a meet g <= denoteGuard b iff g <= denoteGuard (synthesizeGuardIR a b).
synthesizeGuardIR (.nonZero p) (.nonZero p) = .top.
GuardedEquiv (liftEval evalExpr) (denoteGuard ctx) (optimizeExpr ctx e) e.
If evalGuard env ctx = true, then evalExpr env (optimizeExpr ctx e) = evalExpr env e.
Under context nonZero (var 0), optimizeExpr on m1BenchExpr achieves checkedDivCount = 0, guardBranchCount = 0, and execCheckCost = 0.
Under context nonZero (var 0), optimizeExpr on m1CancelExpr achieves divOpCount = 0.
Under trivial context .top when env 0 != 0, optimizeExpr on m1BenchExpr reduces execCheckCost from 2 to at most 1.
Under trivial context .top when env 0 = 0, evalExpr env (optimizeExpr .top m1BenchExpr) = .trap.
For any GuardIR context a, synthesizeGuardIR a .top = .top.
For any target GuardIR b, synthesizeGuardIR .bot b = .top.
For any PureExpr p, synthesizeGuardIR .top (.nonZero p) = .nonZero p.
For any PureExpr p and GuardIR rest, synthesizeGuardIR (.conj (.nonZero p) rest) (.nonZero p) = .top.
For any GuardIR rest and PureExpr p, synthesizeGuardIR (.conj rest (.nonZero p)) (.nonZero p) = .top.
For any PureExpr p, synthesizeGuardIR .top (.conj (.nonZero p) (.nonZero p)) = .nonZero p.

For arbitrary PureExpr operands num, d and extra context extra, optimizeExpr eliminates .checkedDiv (.pure num) (.pure d) under .nonZero d, .conj (.nonZero d) extra, and .conj extra (.nonZero d) with zero guard branches and zero runtime check cost.
For arbitrary PureExpr operands x, d, optimizeExpr (.nonZero d) eliminates all division operations in both mkCancelExpr x d and (d * x) / d.
If optimizeExpr (.nonZero d) achieves checkedDivCount = 0 and guardBranchCount = 0 on subexpressions e1 and e2, then it achieves checkedDivCount = 0 on .add e1 e2, .sub e1 e2, and .mul e1 e2.
For arbitrary PureExpr operands x, y, d and environment env, optimizeExpr (.nonZero d) (mkDualDivExpr x y d) achieves checkedDivCount = 0, guardBranchCount = 0, and execCheckCost = 0.
For arbitrary PureExpr operands x, y, d and environment env with evalPure env d != 0, optimizeExpr .top (mkDualDivExpr x y d) reduces execCheckCost from 2 to at most 1.
For arbitrary PureExpr operands x, y, d and environment env with evalPure env d = 0, evalExpr env (optimizeExpr .top (mkDualDivExpr x y d)) = .trap.
Computable syntactic weakest-precondition pullback of a GuardIR predicate across an imperative Stmt.
Computable edge guard synthesis across an imperative Stmt from pre-context a to post-requirement b.
Computable context-sensitive block optimizer across BlockProg statement prefixes and terminal return expressions.
GuardedEquiv (pullbackEval (stateTransfer step) (liftEval run)) P t1 t2 iff forall s, P s -> run (step s) t1 = run (step s) t2.
denoteGuard (pullbackGuardIR s g) = (stateTransfer (execStmt s)).pullback (denoteGuard g).
denoteGuard (pullbackGuardIR (.seq s1 s2) g) = ((stateTransfer (execStmt s1)).comp (stateTransfer (execStmt s2))).pullback (denoteGuard g).
denoteGuard (synthesizeStmtGuardIR s a b) = synthesizeEdgeGuard (stateTransfer (execStmt s)) (denoteGuard a) (denoteGuard b).
ForcesAfter (stateTransfer (execStmt s)) (denoteGuard a meet g) (denoteGuard b) iff g <= denoteGuard (synthesizeStmtGuardIR s a b).

Given GuardedEquiv (liftEval evalExpr) (denoteGuard req) e1 e2, conjoining ctx with GuardIR.conj (synthesizeStmtGuardIR s1 ctx req) (synthesizeStmtGuardIR s2 ctx req) guarantees identical outcomes after both s1 and s2.
For any integer n != 0, synthesizeStmtGuardIR .skip .top (.nonZero (.lit n)) = .top.
For any variable v and PureExpr rhs, synthesizeStmtGuardIR (.assign v rhs) (.nonZero rhs) (.nonZero (.var v)) = .top.
For any variables x, d and integer n != 0, synthesizeStmtGuardIR (.ite (.eq (.var x) (.lit 0)) (.assign d (.lit n)) (.assign d (.var x))) .top (.nonZero (.var d)) = .top.
GuardedEquiv (liftEval evalBlock) (denoteGuard ctx) (optimizeBlock ctx prog) prog.
If evalGuard env ctx = true, then evalBlock env (optimizeBlock ctx prog) = evalBlock env prog.

For arbitrary num, y, n != 0, and env, optimizeBlock .top on { body := .skip, ret := mkDualDivExpr num y (.lit n) } achieves checkedDivCount = 0, divOpCount <= 1, guardBranchCount = 0, and execBlockCheckCost = 0.
For d != x and arbitrary num, y, env, optimizeBlock (.nonZero (.var x)) (mkClobberBlock x d num y d) achieves checkedDivCount = 0, divOpCount <= 1, guardBranchCount = 0, and execBlockCheckCost = 0.
When evalGuard env (.nonZero (.var x)) = true, evalBlock env (optimizeBlock (.nonZero (.var x)) (mkClobberBlock x d num y x)) = .trap.
For n != 0 and arbitrary x, d, num, y, env, optimizeBlock .top (mkDiamondSafeBlock x d n num y) eliminates checked divisions and guard branches and reduces execBlockCheckCost from 3 to at most 1.

For n != 0 and arbitrary p, d, y, env, optimizeBlock (.nonZero p) (mkDeadBranchBlock p d n y) prunes the dead branch, cancels division completely (divOpCount = 0), and achieves execBlockCheckCost = 0.
